title: root_cause_classification
description: Where the fix for a confirmed deviation belongs.

rootCause.description: agent: the agent had what it needed and still behaved wrongly — the fix is the prompt. data: the agent followed its instructions but a mapping, category list or reference table was wrong or missing — the fix is that data. sow: the clause itself is ambiguous or silent, so the agent was not clearly wrong — the fix is the clause. unknown: the evidence does not distinguish these.

rootCauseLabel.description: A short noun phrase naming the cause, e.g. 'Prompt has no tool-failure path' or 'Mapping table missing museum zone'.

rootCauseDetail.description: One sentence explaining why this is the cause rather than the other candidates.

needsHuman.description: True when correcting the underlying cause still leaves real-world work undone — an unlogged fault, a missed escalation, a visit that must be rebooked. A prompt fix does not cool a food court.

confidence.description: Confidence in this classification, between 0 and 1 inclusive.
